h: Truth and Peace Complete the Blessing of Shabbos

p: may place upon us blessing and peace."
that the blessing of Birkas Kohanim
which corresponds to the third meal
is "May Hashem lift His face," etc.;
for this meal corresponds to Yaakov Avinu;
and it says in the holy Zohar
are bound one with the other."
For peace is the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik,
and it says in Midrash Rabbah
when he fell into their hand,
for it is written of them (Bereishis 37:4):
"And they could not speak to him peaceably."
And this is the main root of the exiles:
that one who is not clean of this blemish
cannot attain the attribute of peace.
that since they were clean in this,
that "whoever disqualifies, disqualifies with his own blemish"
"Let us go and take hold of the way of the world:
was he not cursed to be a slave?
and was cursed to be a slave
the destruction of the Second Temple too
branches out from the blemish of the covenant
and one who is clean of this blemish,
And likewise the conclusion of the Mishnah,
that the Holy One, blessed be He, hid
"The Holy One, blessed be He, found
no vessel that holds blessing for Yisrael
And likewise every dispute in the Talmud:
even a father and his son,
who engage in Torah in one gate,
and they do not move from there
עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ אוֹהֲבִים זֶה אֶת זֶה
until they become friends of one another
And regarding the dispute of Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel,
unless there will afterward be peace,
for truth and peace are bound one with the other.
as written in the holy Zohar
may place upon us blessing and peace."
when the Shabbos day has already passed in observance
for through the attribute of peace
and the subjugation of the kingdoms,

p: And for the first two meals of Shabbos
but for the third meal they did not institute it;
and the Arizal wrote the reason:
that wine is the aspect of Binah,
is the aspect of simple mercy,
which is higher in level than Binah.
to the wine of the Oral Torah,
as written in the Ra'aya Mehemna
one who understands one thing from another,
the aspect of the Oral Torah,
which understands from within the wisdom,
and therefore Kiddush over wine was instituted,
so that through it we merit
the light of the wine of the Oral Torah.
which is the radiance of Zeir Anpin,
לָכֵן לֹא נִתְקַן קִידּוּשׁ עַל הַיַּיִן
therefore Kiddush over wine was not instituted

inlineHeadings.text: The Third Meal Beyond the Wine
